title: Local section vanishes after restriction away from bounded closed support
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-support-dimension-union, every section on an etale object becomes zero after restriction to the complement of a closed subset of dimension at most a, after passing to an etale covering.

source.place: Tag 04FR and finite-type dimension argument Tag 0B1C

proof.text: Represent the section on an affine finite-type etale neighbourhood. The largest open on which its geometric germs vanish has closed complement with finitely many irreducible components. The generic point of every component has nonzero germ, so the stalk hypothesis bounds the transcendence degree of its image in B. The closure of each image has dimension at most a; the finite union Z of these closures contains the image of the nonzero locus. Therefore the restriction of the section to the complement of Z is zero after an etale refinement.
